background: BNY is the holding company of the world's largest custodian bank, earning fees from safekeeping, settlement, asset servicing and investment management for institutions rather than from lending.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, with one on a positive outlook placed on 26 Oct 2026, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 5 Nov 2024. Capital is mixed against US banks: CET1 of 11.0% is in the bottom quarter but leverage of 6.7% is in the top quarter. LCR of 111% is just below the peer median. CET1 has fallen 0.5 points since 30 Jun 2025, while Tier 1 leverage has risen 0.5 points since 31 Dec 2021.
